notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). RAWG's first search result for "Ratchet & Clank" was the wrong entry ("Ratchet & Clank Collection", 2012), so the detail for slug "ratchet-clank" (id 2553, 2016-04-12, PlayStation 4) was fetched and used instead. Steam has no app for this game (the only Steam match was "Ratchet & Clank: Rift Apart", a different game), so steam is none. StrategyWiki has no page under "Ratchet & Clank (2016)", "Ratchet & Clank (2016 video game)" or "Ratchet & Clank (2016 game)". ratchetandclank.fandom.com has no page under "Ratchet & Clank (2016)" but answers under "Ratchet & Clank (2016 game)", with about 129 linked pages, including planet pages such as "Veldin", "Kerwan" and "Kalebo III" and item pages such as "Gold bolt", "Holocard" and "Raritanium". The chapter order comes from the section headings of the Fandom page "Ratchet & Clank (2016 game) gold bolt locations" (Veldin, Kerwan, Aridia, Rilgar, Nebula G34, Gaspar, Batalia, Pokitaru, Quartu, Kalebo III, Deplanetizer); that order is probably the play order, but this was not confirmed. Fandom also links other planets (Novalis, Umbris, Oltanis, Orxon, Hoven) that have no gold bolt section, so where they fit is unknown and they are left out of the chapter titles. Names only were looked at; nothing was copied.
